editorial.blurb: Avec River North delivers an exceptional Mediterranean experience where thoughtfully composed small plates and impeccable service create one of the city's most memorable dinners.
editorial.insiderTip: Order family-style and be adventurous—ask your server (they know the menu deeply) to surprise you with dishes outside your usual comfort zone, especially the seasonal pasta specials.
signatureDishes: Chickpea Hummus with Crispy Short Rib
